method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 打开小屋，让 Tommy 先进去。
facts.anchor: She unlocks the cottage and lets him inside first.

facts.fact: Tommy 探头看每个房间，只说里面看起来不一样。
facts.anchor: “Looks different from inside,” is all he says.

facts.fact: Tommy 洗澡时，Hattie 煎了鸡蛋、培根、土豆饼并烤了几片吐司。
facts.anchor: While Tommy showers she cooks eggs, bacon, and hash browns along with several pieces of toast.

facts.fact: Tommy 起初拨弄食物，随后狼吞虎咽地吃起来。
facts.anchor: At first, he picks at the food, then eats ravenously.

facts.fact: 天亮时 Hattie 把 Tommy 安顿在客房，门留了一条缝。
facts.anchor: It’s dawn when she gets him settled in the guest room. She begins to pull the door closed but leaves it partially open instead

facts.fact: 她惊讶于 Tommy 轻微的鼾声和 Julian 的一模一样。
facts.anchor: She marvels at how his light snoring is the same as Julian’s.

facts.fact: Hattie 伸手想拨开他额前头发却停住，只把毯子往上拉了拉。
facts.anchor: Hattie reaches out to brush some hair off his forehead but stops herself.

facts.fact: Hattie 对 Ed 说“我们的儿子回家了”。
facts.anchor: “Our boy is home,” she says, speaking to Ed.

facts.fact: 她低声承诺再也不会放他走。
facts.anchor: “I won’t let him go again,” she murmurs as sleep takes her hand and begins leading her away. “I promise.”
